technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX, long-term MAs) conflicts with weak short-term momentum (RSI9 oversold, MACD bearish, three black crows), creating a mixed setup unsuitable for high-probability swing entry without additional confirmation.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional signal and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (421.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings binary event in 2 days create a highly adverse risk environment for DTE.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend structure, bullish EMA 50/200 alignment, and extreme fear sentiment (23/100) create a contrarian accumulation setup for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 2 days, crisis VIX, bearish MACD with negative histogram, three black crows pattern, weak volume support (OBV false), and price below both EMA 9 and EMA 20 make this a high-risk, low-probability entry with unfavorable risk/reward.
